conversations.title: Asking for WiFi Password
conversations.description: Ask the host for the WiFi password and find it in the room.

messages.text: Buongiorno! Ti sei sistemato bene in camera?
messages.english: Good morning! Have you settled in well in your room?

choices.text: Sì, grazie. È molto comoda.
choices.english: Yes, thanks. It is very comfortable.
choices.feedback: Perfect response. Confirming you are comfortable.

choices.text: Dov'è il bagno di sopra?
choices.english: Where is the bathroom upstairs?
choices.feedback: A bit abrupt! Answer the host's question first.

choices.text: Ho fame, dove si mangia?
choices.english: I'm hungry, where do we eat?
choices.feedback: Irrelevant to settling into the room.

messages.text: Bene. Hai bisogno di qualcosa in particolare?
messages.english: Good. Do you need anything in particular?

choices.text: Sì, qual è la password del wifi?
choices.english: Yes, what is the wifi password?
choices.feedback: Great. Asking for essential information.

choices.text: No, non mi serve proprio nulla.
choices.english: No, I don't need anything at all.
choices.feedback: Technically correct, but you need the wifi!

choices.text: Il letto è troppo morbido qui.
choices.english: The bed is too soft here.
choices.feedback: Complaining instead of asking for what you need.

messages.text: La trovi su un foglio sopra il tavolo. La vedi?
messages.english: You can find it on a piece of paper on the table. Do you see it?

choices.text: Ah sì, vedo il foglio. È quella con molti numeri?
choices.english: Ah yes, I see the paper. Is it the one with many numbers?
choices.feedback: Correct identification of the paper.

choices.text: Non vedo nessun tavolo in cucina.
choices.english: I don't see any table in the kitchen.
choices.feedback: The host said it's in your room!

choices.text: Voglio un foglio bianco per me.
choices.english: I want a white sheet for myself.
choices.feedback: You are looking for the password, not blank paper.

messages.text: Esatto. È scritta tutta in maiuscolo.
messages.english: Exactly. It is written all in uppercase.

choices.text: Va bene. Devo mettere anche il trattino?
choices.english: Alright. Do I also need to put the dash?
choices.feedback: Good question about the password format.

choices.text: Posso scrivere con la penna blu?
choices.english: Can I write with the blue pen?
choices.feedback: You are entering a password, not writing.

choices.text: Il mio nome è scritto in minuscolo.
choices.english: My name is written in lowercase.
choices.feedback: Irrelevant to the password on the paper.

messages.text: No, solo i numeri e le lettere. Prova ora.
messages.english: No, just the numbers and letters. Try now.

choices.text: Funziona perfettamente! Grazie mille.
choices.english: It works perfectly! Thanks a lot.
choices.feedback: Success! You are connected.

choices.text: Il router è rotto, non va bene.
choices.english: The router is broken, it's not good.
choices.feedback: It just worked! Don't complain now.

choices.text: Mi serve un tecnico molto bravo.
choices.english: I need a very good technician.
choices.feedback: No need for a technician if it works.

messages.text: Prego. Ti serve altro per il tuo lavoro o studio?
messages.english: You're welcome. Do you need anything else for your work or study?

choices.text: No, per ora sono a posto così.
choices.english: No, for now I'm fine like this.
choices.feedback: Politely declining further help.

choices.text: Voglio comprare un libro di storia.
choices.english: I want to buy a history book.
choices.feedback: The host is asking about your current needs in the room.

choices.text: Dov'è la biblioteca più vicina?
choices.english: Where is the nearest library?
choices.feedback: A bit off-topic for the current conversation.

messages.text: Ottimo. Ti ricordo che il segnale è più forte in salotto.
messages.english: Great. I remind you that the signal is stronger in the living room.

choices.text: Grazie dell'informazione, lo terrò a mente.
choices.english: Thanks for the info, I'll keep it in mind.
choices.feedback: Acknowledging the helpful tip.

choices.text: Il salotto è troppo grande per me.
choices.english: The living room is too big for me.
choices.feedback: Irrelevant to the wifi signal strength.

choices.text: Non mi piace il colore del divano.
choices.english: I don't like the color of the sofa.
choices.feedback: Complaining instead of being thankful for the tip.

messages.text: Se hai problemi, puoi chiamarmi in qualsiasi momento.
messages.english: If you have problems, you can call me at any time.

choices.text: Molto gentile, spero di non disturbare.
choices.english: Very kind, I hope not to disturb.
choices.feedback: Polite and considerate response.

choices.text: Ti chiamo alle tre di notte.
choices.english: I'll call you at three in the morning.
choices.feedback: That would be very rude!

choices.text: Ho perso il mio numero di telefono.
choices.feedback: Doesn't make sense in this context.

messages.text: Non ti preoccupare, è il mio lavoro. Buona navigazione!
messages.english: Don't worry, it's my job. Happy browsing!

choices.text: Grazie ancora, buona giornata a lei.
choices.english: Thanks again, have a good day.
choices.feedback: Ending the conversation politely.

choices.text: Non voglio navigare in mare.
choices.english: I don't want to sail at sea.
choices.feedback: The host means browsing the internet!

choices.text: Il lavoro è molto faticoso oggi.
choices.feedback: The host is talking about their job, not yours.

messages.text: Anche a te. A presto!
messages.english: To you too. See you soon!

choices.text: Arrivederci!
choices.english: Goodbye!
choices.feedback: Standard polite closing.

choices.text: Buongiorno!
choices.english: Good morning!
choices.feedback: You are saying goodbye, not hello.

choices.text: Cosa?
choices.english: What?
choices.feedback: Too abrupt for a farewell.

conversations.title: Reporting No Connection
conversations.description: Report that the WiFi is not working and check the router.

messages.text: Ciao! Tutto bene con l'appartamento?
messages.english: Hi! Everything okay with the apartment?

choices.text: Veramente ho un piccolo problema.
choices.english: Actually, I have a small problem.
choices.feedback: Good way to start reporting an issue.

choices.text: Mi piace molto questo divano.
choices.english: I like this sofa very much.
choices.feedback: Nice, but you have a problem to report!

choices.text: Non trovo le chiavi di casa.
choices.english: I can't find the house keys.
choices.feedback: You are already inside the apartment!

messages.text: Dimmi pure, cosa succede?
messages.english: Tell me, what's happening?

choices.text: Il wifi non funziona sul mio telefono.
choices.english: The wifi doesn't work on my phone.
choices.feedback: Clearly stating the problem.

choices.text: Il mio telefono è nuovo di zecca.
choices.english: My phone is brand new.
choices.feedback: The host needs to know about the connection, not the phone age.

choices.text: C'è troppa luce in questa stanza.
choices.english: There is too much light in this room.
choices.feedback: Irrelevant to the wifi problem.

messages.text: Strano, di solito va bene. Vedi la rete?
messages.english: Strange, it usually works well. Do you see the network?

choices.text: No, non vedo proprio il nome della rete.
choices.english: No, I don't see the network name at all.
choices.feedback: Confirming the network is invisible.

choices.text: Sì, vedo il mare dalla finestra.
choices.english: Yes, I see the sea from the window.
choices.feedback: The host is talking about the wifi network!

choices.text: Non vedo l'ora di uscire fuori.
choices.english: I can't wait to go outside.
choices.feedback: Irrelevant to the technical question.

messages.text: Forse il router è spento. È nel salotto.
messages.english: Maybe the router is off. It's in the living room.

choices.text: Controllo subito... sì, le luci sono spente.
choices.english: I'll check right away... yes, the lights are off.
choices.feedback: Good observation of the router status.

choices.text: Vago in cucina a cercare il pane.
choices.english: I wander into the kitchen to look for bread.
choices.feedback: The router is in the living room!

choices.text: Le luci del bagno sono accese ora.
choices.english: The bathroom lights are on now.
choices.feedback: Wrong lights!

messages.text: Prova a premere il tasto di accensione dietro.
messages.english: Try pressing the power button on the back.

choices.text: L'ho premuto. Adesso la luce è verde.
choices.english: I pressed it. Now the light is green.
choices.feedback: Success! You turned it on.

choices.text: Ho rotto il televisore del salotto.
choices.english: I broke the living room TV.
choices.feedback: Don't break things! Just press the button.

choices.text: Non trovo il telecomando nero.
choices.english: I can't find the black remote.
choices.feedback: You need the power button on the router.

messages.text: Bene, ora aspetta che la luce diventi fissa.
messages.english: Good, now wait for the light to become steady.

choices.text: Quanto tempo ci vuole di solito?
choices.english: How much time does it usually take?
choices.feedback: Asking for expected duration.

choices.text: Voglio andare a mangiare una pizza.
choices.english: I want to go eat a pizza.
choices.feedback: Wait for the wifi first!

choices.text: Il tempo è molto bello oggi.
choices.feedback: Talking about the weather instead of the router.

messages.text: Solo un minuto o due. Vedi qualcosa adesso?
messages.english: Just a minute or two. Do you see anything now?

choices.text: Sì, ora vedo il nome della rete "Home_Wifi".
choices.english: Yes, now I see the network name "Home_Wifi".
choices.feedback: Identifying the network correctly.

choices.text: Vedo un gatto nero in giardino.
choices.english: I see a black cat in the garden.
choices.feedback: The host is asking about the wifi list!

choices.text: Non vedo nulla, è tutto nero.
choices.english: I don't see anything, it's all black.
choices.feedback: Check the screen of your phone.

messages.text: Perfetto. Prova a connetterti usando la password.
messages.english: Perfect. Try to connect using the password.

choices.text: Sto inserendo la password... sembra che funzioni.
choices.english: I'm entering the password... it seems to be working.
choices.feedback: Attempting connection and reporting success.

choices.text: La password è il mio compleanno.
choices.english: The password is my birthday.
choices.feedback: No, use the password given by the host!

choices.text: Non mi piacciono le password lunghe.
choices.feedback: Just enter it to get connected.

messages.text: Ottimo. La velocità ti sembra buona?
messages.english: Great. Does the speed seem good to you?

choices.text: Sì, ora è molto veloce. Grazie per l'aiuto!
choices.english: Yes, now it's very fast. Thanks for the help!
choices.feedback: Confirming good speed and thanking the host.

choices.text: La macchina è molto veloce in autostrada.
choices.english: The car is very fast on the highway.
choices.feedback: The host is talking about the internet speed.

choices.text: Sono molto lento a scrivere oggi.
choices.feedback: Off-topic.

messages.text: Di nulla. Se succede di nuovo, sai cosa fare.
messages.english: You're welcome. If it happens again, you know what to do.

choices.text: Certamente, grazie ancora e buona serata.
choices.english: Certainly, thanks again and good evening.
choices.feedback: Closing the conversation politely.

choices.text: Non so mai cosa fare in cucina.
choices.english: I never know what to do in the kitchen.
choices.feedback: The host means you know how to fix the wifi now.

choices.text: Di che colore è il router?
choices.english: What color is the router?
choices.feedback: You already found it!

conversations.title: Slow Internet Speed
conversations.description: Complain about slow internet and find a better spot.

messages.text: Buonasera. Va tutto bene per il tuo soggiorno?
messages.english: Good evening. Is everything okay with your stay?

choices.text: Buonasera. La connessione internet è molto lenta.
choices.english: Good evening. The internet connection is very slow.
choices.feedback: Reporting the speed issue politely.

choices.text: Voglio andare a dormire presto stasera.
choices.english: I want to go to sleep early tonight.
choices.feedback: Irrelevant to the host's question about the stay quality.

choices.text: Il caffè è freddo e non mi piace.
choices.english: The coffee is cold and I don't like it.
choices.feedback: Wrong topic!

messages.text: Mi dispiace. Non riesci a navigare bene?
messages.english: I'm sorry. Are you not able to browse well?

choices.text: No, le pagine caricano molto piano.
choices.english: No, the pages load very slowly.
choices.feedback: Describing the browsing experience.

choices.text: Sì, mi piace molto andare in barca.
choices.english: Yes, I like going by boat very much.
choices.feedback: 'Navigare' here means browsing the web, not sailing!

choices.text: Le scarpe sono troppo strette per me.
choices.english: The shoes are too tight for me.
choices.feedback: Completely off-topic.

messages.text: Quanti dispositivi sono collegati?
messages.english: How many devices are connected?

choices.text: Solo il mio computer e il mio tablet.
choices.english: Only my computer and my tablet.
choices.feedback: Answering the technical question accurately.

choices.text: Ho tre valigie molto pesanti qui.
choices.english: I have three very heavy suitcases here.
choices.feedback: Suitcases are not internet devices!

choices.text: Ci sono quattro sedie in cucina.
choices.english: There are four chairs in the kitchen.
choices.feedback: The host is asking about electronics.

messages.text: Forse il segnale è debole in quella camera.
messages.english: Maybe the signal is weak in that room.

choices.text: Cosa posso fare per migliorare la velocità?
choices.english: What can I do to improve the speed?
choices.feedback: Asking for a solution.

choices.text: Mi serve un cuscino più grande.
choices.english: I need a larger pillow.
choices.feedback: A pillow won't help the wifi signal!

choices.text: Il segnale stradale è proprio lì.
choices.english: The road sign is right there.
choices.feedback: Wrong kind of signal.

messages.text: Prova ad avvicinarti al router nel corridoio.
messages.english: Try getting closer to the router in the hallway.

choices.text: Va bene, mi sposto subito con il pc.
choices.english: Alright, I'll move right away with the pc.
choices.feedback: Following the host's suggestion.

choices.text: Non voglio camminare fino al mare.
choices.english: I don't want to walk to the sea.
choices.feedback: The hallway is inside the apartment!

choices.text: Il pc è spento e non lo trovo.
choices.english: The pc is off and I can't find it.
choices.feedback: You were just using it!

messages.text: Fammi sapere se la situazione migliora lì.
messages.english: Let me know if the situation improves there.

choices.text: Sì, qui vicino al router sembra andare meglio.
choices.english: Yes, here near the router it seems to go better.
choices.feedback: Reporting improvement in a better location.

choices.text: Mi piace il mare in questa stagione.
choices.english: I like the sea in this season.
choices.feedback: Irrelevant to the wifi situation.

choices.text: La cucina è troppo piccola qui.
choices.english: The kitchen is too small here.
choices.feedback: Off-topic.

messages.text: Magari c'è qualche interferenza vicino al letto.
messages.english: Maybe there is some interference near the bed.

choices.text: È possibile, ci sono molti specchi in camera.
choices.english: It's possible, there are many mirrors in the room.
choices.feedback: Providing a possible explanation for the interference.

choices.text: Voglio dormire sul divano stasera.
choices.english: I want to sleep on the sofa tonight.
choices.feedback: The host is talking about interference, not your sleep plans.

choices.text: Gli specchi sono sporchi di polvere.
choices.english: The mirrors are dirty with dust.
choices.feedback: Focus on the technical problem instead of cleaning.

messages.text: Ah, gli specchi possono bloccare il segnale wifi.
messages.english: Ah, mirrors can block the wifi signal.

choices.text: Non lo sapevo, è molto interessante.
choices.english: I didn't know that, it's very interesting.
choices.feedback: Learning something new about tech.

choices.text: Non mi interessa la scienza oggi.
choices.english: I'm not interested in science today.
choices.feedback: Politeness is important even when talking about tech.

choices.text: Voglio comprare uno specchio nuovo.
choices.english: I want to buy a new mirror.
choices.feedback: Not necessary!

messages.text: Comunque, se hai ancora problemi, resetto il modem.
messages.english: Anyway, if you still have problems, I'll reset the modem.

choices.text: Per ora va bene così, grazie mille.
choices.english: For now it's fine like this, thanks a lot.
choices.feedback: Politely declining the reset for now.

choices.text: Voglio un modem di colore rosso.
choices.english: I want a red modem.
choices.feedback: The color doesn't matter for the connection!

choices.text: Il modem è troppo vecchio per me.
choices.english: The modem is too old for me.
choices.feedback: Don't be demanding.

messages.text: Va bene. Buona serata e buon lavoro!
messages.english: Alright. Good evening and good work!

choices.text: Grazie, altrettanto!
choices.english: Thanks, same to you!
choices.feedback: Standard polite closing.

choices.text: Buonanotte!
choices.english: Good night!
choices.feedback: A bit early for good night!

choices.text: Chi lavora oggi?
choices.english: Who is working today?
choices.feedback: Unnecessary question.

conversations.title: Router Reset Instructions
conversations.description: Reset the router following the host's instructions.

messages.text: Pronto? Mi avevi mandato un messaggio?
messages.english: Hello? Had you sent me a message?

choices.text: Sì, la rete internet è sparita di nuovo.
choices.english: Yes, the internet network has disappeared again.
choices.feedback: Confirming why you contacted them.

choices.text: No, sto parlando con un amico ora.
choices.english: No, I'm talking to a friend now.
choices.feedback: Then why did you call the host?

choices.text: Il messaggio è per il mio dottore.
choices.english: The message is for my doctor.
choices.feedback: The host received it, so it was for them!

messages.text: Ah, purtroppo ogni tanto capita. Bisogna riavviare.
messages.english: Ah, unfortunately it happens sometimes. It needs to be restarted.

choices.text: Devo staccare il cavo della corrente?
choices.english: Do I have to unplug the power cable?
choices.feedback: Asking for the correct reset procedure.

choices.text: Devo comprare un router nuovo subito?
choices.english: Do I have to buy a new router immediately?
choices.feedback: Try restarting it first as suggested.

choices.text: Il cavo dell'acqua è rotto qui.
choices.english: The water cable is broken here.
choices.feedback: Wrong cable!

messages.text: Sì, stacca il cavo nero e aspetta un minuto.
messages.english: Yes, unplug the black cable and wait a minute.

choices.text: Va bene, l'ho staccato. Aspetto un momento.
choices.english: Alright, I unplugged it. I'll wait a moment.
choices.feedback: Following the steps accurately.

choices.text: Ho tagliato il cavo con le forbici.
choices.english: I cut the cable with scissors.
choices.feedback: No! Just unplug it, don't cut it!

choices.text: Il minuto è passato un'ora fa.
choices.english: The minute passed an hour ago.
choices.feedback: Be patient and wait as instructed.

messages.text: Ora riattacca il cavo e guarda le luci.
messages.english: Now plug the cable back in and look at the lights.

choices.text: La luce rossa sta lampeggiando adesso.
choices.english: The red light is flashing now.
choices.feedback: Good observation of the router's behavior.

choices.text: Ho spento la luce della cucina.
choices.english: I turned off the kitchen light.
choices.feedback: The host means the router lights!

choices.text: Non vedo nulla perché è buio.
choices.english: I don't see anything because it's dark.
choices.feedback: Look at the small lights on the device.

messages.text: È normale. Aspetta che diventi fissa e verde.
messages.english: It's normal. Wait for it to become steady and green.

choices.text: Ok, ora è verde. Controllo la connessione.
choices.english: Ok, now it's green. I'm checking the connection.
choices.feedback: Waiting for the signal and checking.

choices.text: Il semaforo è diventato verde ora.
choices.english: The traffic light has turned green now.
choices.feedback: You are inside, not at a traffic light!

choices.text: La luce è blu come il cielo.
choices.english: The light is blue like the sky.
choices.feedback: The host said it should be green.

messages.text: Allora, riesci a collegarti adesso?
messages.english: So, are you able to connect now?

choices.text: Sì, ora la connessione è tornata.
choices.english: Yes, now the connection is back.
choices.feedback: Confirming the internet is back.

choices.text: Sono collegato alla radio adesso.
choices.english: I'm connected to the radio now.
choices.feedback: The host is asking about the internet.

choices.text: Non voglio collegarmi a nessuno.
choices.english: I don't want to connect to anyone.
choices.feedback: You need the connection!

messages.text: Meno male. A volte il sistema si blocca.
messages.english: Thank goodness. Sometimes the system freezes.

choices.text: Succede spesso con questo modello di router?
choices.english: Does it happen often with this router model?
choices.feedback: Asking for more information about the device.

choices.text: Il sistema solare è molto grande.
choices.english: The solar system is very large.
choices.feedback: The host means the router's system.

choices.text: Mi sono bloccato in ascensore.
choices.english: I got stuck in the elevator.
choices.feedback: Not relevant here.

messages.text: Solo quando fa molto caldo, purtroppo.
messages.english: Only when it's very hot, unfortunately.

choices.text: Capisco. Forse devo tenerlo in un posto più fresco.
choices.english: I see. Maybe I should keep it in a cooler place.
choices.feedback: Suggesting a solution to prevent overheating.

choices.text: Voglio mangiare un gelato fresco.
choices.english: I want to eat a fresh ice cream.
choices.feedback: That won't help the router!

choices.text: Il caldo è terribile oggi fuori.
choices.feedback: Focus on the router's location.

messages.text: Sì, sarebbe meglio. Scusami per il disturbo.
messages.english: Yes, it would be better. Sorry for the inconvenience.

choices.text: Non si preoccupi, ora funziona tutto bene.
choices.english: Don't worry, everything is working fine now.
choices.feedback: Reassuring the host.

choices.text: Il disturbo della radio è forte.
choices.english: The radio interference is strong.
choices.feedback: The host is apologizing, not talking about radio.

choices.text: Mi sento molto disturbato qui.
choices.feedback: A bit too dramatic.

messages.text: Ottimo. Se hai bisogno, io sono qui. Ciao!
messages.english: Great. If you need anything, I'm here. Bye!

choices.text: Grazie, ciao e buona giornata!
choices.english: Thanks, bye and have a good day!
choices.feedback: Ending the call politely.

choices.text: D'accordo, arrivederci e grazie.
choices.english: Alright, goodbye and thanks.
choices.feedback: A bit formal, but you already said thanks earlier. The correct answer is more natural.

choices.text: Dov'è il bagno?
choices.english: Where is the bathroom?
choices.feedback: Not the time to ask this.
